purpose: Adopt the observed urn:kumwe:problem type URIs as a finite versioned registry with declared HTTP statuses, retry classes and typed extension members, so a client acts on stable codes instead of parsing human detail text. Codes currently live at individual call sites without a registry, statuses or compatibility promise; this proposal seeds the registry exclusively from type URIs observed at the audited commit and adds no invented failure behavior.

extension_members.name: request_id
extension_members.purpose: Correlation identifier already emitted with problem responses; adoption declares it a stable member.

extension_members.name: field_violations
extension_members.purpose: Bounded list binding each validation failure to the exact input field, its stable code and a redacted message.

extension_members.name: expected_version
extension_members.purpose: Version the precondition required, returned with stale-precondition failures.

extension_members.name: actual_version
extension_members.purpose: Current authoritative version, returned with stale-precondition failures.

extension_members.name: retry_after_seconds
extension_members.purpose: Machine copy of the Retry-After delay for transient failures, so the delay survives intermediaries that strip headers.

entries.title: Validation failed
entries.summary: The request was well-formed but one or more values violate the resource contract.

entries.title: Authorization denied
entries.summary: The authenticated caller may not perform this operation; missing and denied resources stay indistinguishable.

entries.title: Insufficient capability
entries.summary: The credential lacks the route capability required for this operation.

entries.title: Authentication throttled
entries.summary: Authentication attempts are rate limited; retry after the advertised delay.

entries.title: Step-up required
entries.summary: The operation needs fresh session-bound step-up proof that bearer credentials cannot supply; native surfaces report the operation unsupported.

entries.title: High-impact authentication required
entries.summary: Consuming a high-impact approval requires a fresh authenticator proof bound to a browser session.

entries.title: Precondition failed
entries.summary: The supplied If-Match validator is stale; re-read the resource and decide with the fresh version.

entries.title: Precondition required
entries.summary: The mutation needs an If-Match validator and none was supplied.

entries.title: Invalid If-Match
entries.summary: The If-Match header is malformed or uses a weak validator.

entries.title: Idempotency key required
entries.summary: The mutation needs a caller-generated Idempotency-Key header and none was supplied.

entries.title: Invalid idempotency key
entries.summary: The Idempotency-Key header violates the 8 to 128 character contract.

entries.title: Idempotency key reused
entries.summary: The key was already used with different request data; mint a new key for the new intent.

entries.title: Idempotent request in progress
entries.summary: An identical request currently holds the processing lease; retry after it completes.

entries.title: Idempotent replay authorization changed
entries.summary: The replaying credential differs from the credential that started the operation; the replay is refused.

entries.title: Contract temporarily unavailable
entries.summary: The caller-specific OpenAPI contract failed a current-generation invariant and is served no-store with a retry delay.

entries.title: Content not found
entries.summary: No visible content record has this identity.

entries.title: Navigation not found
entries.summary: No visible menu or menu item has this identity.

entries.title: Automation not found
entries.summary: No visible schedule or job has this identity.

entries.title: Business definition not found
entries.summary: No policy-visible business definition has this identity.

entries.title: Business record not found
entries.summary: No policy-visible business record has this identity; denial is indistinguishable by design.

entries.title: Business operation not found
entries.summary: No caller-bound operation result has this identity.

entries.title: Business approval not found
entries.summary: No visible approval request has this identity.

entries.title: Business schema not found
entries.summary: No visible business schema draft or plan has this identity.

entries.title: Business schema conflict
entries.summary: The schema changed since it was read; re-read the current schema before retrying the change.

entries.title: Business record validation failed
entries.summary: Record values violate the definition schema or its policy-filtered constraints.

entries.title: Business record unique conflict
entries.summary: A unique constraint of the definition rejects the supplied values.

entries.title: Business record reference conflict
entries.summary: A referenced record is missing, invisible or in a state that refuses the reference.

entries.title: Business record unavailable
entries.summary: The record exists but its current lifecycle state excludes this operation.

entries.title: Business action rejected
entries.summary: The typed custom action refused its command input or state binding.

entries.title: Business relationship rejected
entries.summary: The relation mutation violates the definition's relationship contract.

entries.title: Invalid business record query
entries.summary: The bounded query document violates its closed grammar or exceeds a declared limit.

entries.title: Invalid business operation
entries.summary: The operation reference is malformed or not bound to the caller.

entries.title: Invalid business report export
entries.summary: The export request violates the bounded report export contract.

entries.title: Business report validation failed
entries.summary: Report parameters violate the report's declared parameter schema.

entries.title: Business report row limit exceeded
entries.summary: The report result exceeds the bounded row budget; narrow the parameters or use an export.

entries.title: Invalid plan request
entries.summary: The non-executable change plan violates the plan preview contract.

entries.title: Authentication required
entries.summary: The request lacks a valid bearer credential for this site; refusals carry an RFC 6750 challenge.

entries.title: Site context invalid
entries.summary: The Kumwe-Site header is absent, duplicated, or does not match the site bound to the credential.

entries.title: Payload too large
entries.summary: The request body exceeds the declared size bound for this operation.

security_invariants: Human title and detail text is redacted, unstable and never a client control-flow contract; only the stable code and declared extensions are machine surface.
Registry codes never distinguish a denied resource from a missing one where core intentionally merges them.
Field violations disclose only fields the caller was allowed to submit; hidden fields never appear in violation lists.
Extension members carry no secrets, tokens, internal paths, queries or stack detail.
An unknown code is treated as its HTTP status class with retry class unspecified; it never disables validation or authorization handling.
Removing or renaming a published code is a breaking contract revision with a declared migration window.
